papers.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
papers.desc: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure.

papers.title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
papers.desc: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time.

papers.title: Mega-MMDF and DeepfakeBench-MM: Benchmarking Multimodal Deepfake Detection Across Diverse Forgery Pipelines
papers.desc: Audio-visual deepfakes can spread misinformation and enable impersonation, undermining trust in digital media.

papers.title: Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
papers.desc: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network.

papers.title: Separating Measurement Failures from Defence Failures in Split Language-Model Privacy
papers.desc: Split-training privacy evaluations fail through distinct mechanisms.

papers.title: SpatialArena: Where Do Geometric Foundation Models Stand?
papers.desc: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry.

papers.title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
papers.desc: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing.

papers.title: Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA
papers.desc: Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer.

papers.title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
papers.desc: Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities.

papers.title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
papers.desc: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change.

papers.title: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
papers.desc: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers.

papers.title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
papers.desc: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions.

papers.title: FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment
papers.desc: Model alignment is the primary safety and security mechanism for enforcing refusal of malicious prompts in modern foundation models; yet, existing adversarial evaluations implicitly assume underlying hardware integrity.

papers.title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
papers.desc: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries.

papers.title: Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load: Synchronization, Rule Execution and Misfires on the Background
papers.desc: As the load grows, a language model makes more and more errors, but different processes stand behind this decline in quality.
